results.title: Haul Out the Halloween
results.overview: New, Halloween-obsessed neighbors inspire residents of Evergreen Lane to haul out their spookiest costumes and décor to become EverSCREAM Lane.

results.title: Can Accom
results.overview: Two strangers have an awkward post coital encounter.

results.title: Brothers
results.overview: A cautious teen struggles to pull his reckless brother back from the edge, but as their turbulent night unfolds, he's forced to question whether some wounds can ever truly heal.

results.title: Star Signs
results.overview: A psychic goes to a house party and is pressured into using her abilities to read people's star signs. When a Gemini joins in, she envisions horrors that leave her speechless.

results.title: Diam's : De la lumière à l'ombre
results.original_title: Diam's : De la lumière à l'ombre
results.overview: Diam's, the beloved icon of French rap, gave up everything at the height of her success. The young woman experienced a real descent into hell: depression, loneliness, and disillusionment in the face of suffocating fame. On the brink of disaster, she found refuge in religion. Rare archives, memorable music videos, and previously unseen testimonials reveal the violence of her success and her vital need to disappear in order to rebuild herself, choosing the shadows after the light.

results.title: The Golden Voice
results.overview: A young street singer and a homeless veteran, both on a self-destructive path, battle dark times through friendship and music.

results.title: Jamary
results.overview: Ane, a 12-year-old influencer, spends her afternoons playing in the Jamary village, located in the Amazon region. One day, after being challenged by her cousins, Ane ventures into the forest and encounters the Anhangá, a mystical indigenous spirit devoted to protecting the rainforest.

results.title: Tobacco Shop
results.overview: São José Correia recites the watershed futuristic poem Tabacaria from Álvaro de Campos.

results.title: True Artist
results.overview: Rain beats against the car window as Yoshi treats his son to a hamburger. But amid the bites, he struggles to express something that will fundamentally change their lives. Dreams collide with obligations in this sensitively and poetically crafted film about the relationship between a father and son.

results.title: Insaaf: Tale of Legends
results.overview: Yusuf, a brutal underworld kingpin, clashes with a relentless cop as a mysterious vigilante wages war on crime. As loyalties blur and vengeance builds, a high-stakes battle unfolds where justice teeters-hero, villain and avenger converge.

results.title: El infierno de los vivos
results.overview: Mariana, 15, escapes the violence of her home in Santa Fe. She embarks on a search for her biological father and takes refuge in an orphanage where she finds affection from a distant relative. On his journey through the interior of the province, he discovers its inner strength.

results.title: Behind Our House Is a Garden
results.overview: An autobiographical story, set in the city of Grozny in 1994 — its last peaceful year before the outbreak of the First Chechen War, Russia. It follows the life of one family and the tight-knit community of a single courtyard — a place full of warmth, quiet beauty, and the haunting presence of what was to come.

results.title: Poster Boy
results.overview: India Opzoomer crafts a sensitive coming-of-age tale, bringing to life the cutthroat world of boy bands through the crushing story of a desperate 16-year-old who betrays his bandmates in a misguided attempt to secure his spot in the limelight.

results.title: My Love Will Make You Disappear
results.original_title: My Love Will Make You Disappear
results.overview: A woman who believes she's cursed meets a troubled landlord while fighting community displacement. As they grow closer, her fear that all her lovers disappear threatens their connection.

results.title: Resurrection Road
results.overview: An elite squad of six Black soldiers, led by ex-slave Barabbas, have been sent on a suicide mission; to infiltrate a Confederate fort deep in the Arkansas woods and blow up its long-range guns, altering the course of the war.

results.title: Hunting Ground
results.overview: One night, three young men shoot the owners of a hunting lodge. The man who hired them claims he only asked them to do one thing: scare the people who were resisting him. How do you come to kill when you're barely twenty and there's no war going on?

results.title: Mermaids
results.overview: Summer holidays in Greece. A flirt under the scorched sun pushes two opposite friend groups on a journey of sexual discovery, lust, consent, and complete transformation.

results.title: Borowski Und Das Haupt Der Medusa
results.original_title: Borowski Und Das Haupt Der Medusa
results.overview: Borowski has only a few days until his retirement and stumbles upon a terrifying case connected to a dark house. During his investigation, he is pursued by a killer who anticipates his every move and is simultaneously racing against time before his career ends.

results.title: Christmas at Mistletoe Hall
results.overview: When Piper and Dawson are invited home for the holidays, they find themselves unraveling a series of festive clues and heartfelt challenges.
